findings.note: June 2025 NHL.com EDGE piece: in 2024-25 Dobson was sixth among defensemen with 196 shots on goal (about 2.76 per game in 71 games) and had 4+ shots 21 times, which points to a volume shooter. The data is two seasons old.

May 2026: Dobson came back for Game 7 of the first round after missing time since April 11 with an upper-body injury from blocking a shot. He had 47 points in 80 games in 2025-26 and averaged 22:29 of ice time. It gives no shot totals and no current health status.
July 2025 preview: Dobson projected as a top-four right-shot defenseman paired with Matheson and expected to add power-play options. It is outdated and does not confirm his deployment for 2026-27.
